occasions.recipeTitle: Pomegranate & Ras El Hanout Braised Lamb Shoulder
occasions.cuisine: Middle Eastern · North African · For Two · Scales to 12

swaps.text: butternut squash + chickpeas, same spices at 180°C
salmon, half the ras el hanout, 25 min at 200°C
plain chicken thighs, separate pan, mild braising liquid

phases.name: Prep
phases.desc: Score the lamb deeply all over. Rub entirely with ras el hanout, olive oil and a generous amount of salt. Let the spice crust set before searing.

phases.name: Sear
phases.desc: Brown all sides in a heavy casserole over high heat until a deep mahogany crust forms. This is where the flavour lives — don't rush it.

phases.name: Braise
phases.desc: Add aromatics, stock and braising liquid. Cover tight. The house will fill with something extraordinary.

phases.name: Rest
phases.desc: Out of the oven, uncovered. Skim the fat from the braising liquid. Shred coarsely back into the juices with two forks.

phases.name: Serve
phases.desc: Over couscous with cold Greek yogurt, fresh mint, and pomegranate seeds scattered at the last moment. Serve family-style.

pairings: Bold Moroccan Syrah or Côtes du Rhône
Labneh with za'atar & flatbread to start

occasions.recipeTitle: Chipotle Pulled Pork with Quick Pickled Slaw & Warm Tortillas

swaps.text: jackfruit, full chipotle rub, same 4-hour braise
chipotle cauliflower steaks, 45 min at 200°C
plain pulled chicken, separate pot, same station

phases.name: Marinate
phases.desc: Coat the pork shoulder entirely in the chipotle rub. Overnight is ideal — the flavour penetrates deep into the meat and the bark will be extraordinary.

phases.name: Sear
phases.desc: High heat, all sides. Build the deep crust that locks in the juices and forms the bark. This is where the flavour compounds.

phases.name: Slow Cook
phases.desc: Stock and vinegar added. Covered tight. The kitchen will smell incredible all day.

phases.name: Quick Slaw
phases.desc: Shred red cabbage thinly. Toss with vinegar, sugar and salt while the pork cooks. Rest at least 1 hour — it only gets better with time.

phases.name: Shred & Build
phases.desc: Pull pork with two forks, return to juices. Set up the build-your-own station and let the room serve itself. It holds 4+ hours.

pairings: Mexican lager, margaritas, or agua fresca
Elote-style corn to start the evening

occasions.recipeTitle: Slow-Cooked Chicken & Leek Pie with Buttered Mash

swaps.text: mushrooms & root veg, same cream sauce
coconut cream, plant butter, vegan pastry
potato-topped section, no pastry, side of the dish

phases.name: Simmer
phases.desc: Place chicken in stock with leeks, celery, carrots, thyme and bay. Simmer gently until tender. Lift out the chicken and shred the meat from the bone.

phases.name: Make the Sauce
phases.desc: Melt butter in a wide pan. Add flour, cook briefly. Pour in the strained cooking stock and cream. Stir until thick, smooth and deeply savoury.

phases.name: Fill & Top
phases.desc: Fold shredded chicken through the leek sauce. Pour into a baking dish. Top with pastry, crimp edges, egg wash generously, pierce to vent.

phases.name: Bake
phases.desc: Until the pastry is deeply golden and filling is bubbling at the edges. It should look beautiful with very little effort on your part. 180°C / 355°F

phases.name: Rest & Serve
phases.desc: Rest 10 minutes before cutting. Serve at the table with buttered mash and peas. Quiet, generous, entirely uncomplicated.

pairings: Strong tea, warm cider, or a good red wine
Green salad, dressed simply with vinegar

occasions.recipeTitle: Honey & Clementine Glazed Ham with Roast Potatoes & Red Cabbage

swaps.text: glazed cauliflower crown, same glaze, 45 min at 190°C
whole baked salmon with dill and lemon cream
glazed beetroot & lentil Wellington, same table

phases.name: Simmer the Ham
phases.desc: Cover gammon in cold water with bay leaves, onion and peppercorns. Bring to boil, reduce and simmer. This draws out excess salt and starts the tenderness.

phases.name: Glaze
phases.desc: Score the fat in a diamond pattern. Stud each diamond with a clove. Mix honey, clementine, mustard and sugar. Coat every surface generously.

phases.name: Roast & Lacquer
phases.desc: High heat to burnish and caramelise the glaze. Baste twice. The ham should emerge glossy, fragrant and deeply golden. 190°C / 375°F

phases.name: Rest
phases.desc: Cover loosely with foil. The resting is non-negotiable — it makes the ham carveable and keeps every slice juicy and intact at the table.

phases.name: Carve & Serve
phases.desc: Serve on a board at the table. The drama of carving is part of the occasion. Cold slices the next day in white rolls with English mustard are the point.

pairings: Good Burgundy or spiced mulled wine
Cheese board and crackers afterwards

occasions.recipeTitle: Build-Your-Own Mini Sliders with Secret Sauce & Oven Fries

swaps.text: black bean & sweetcorn patties, same spices
portobello mushroom, soy & smoked paprika marinade
plain beef, no seasoning, cheese only, separate pile

phases.name: Season & Form
phases.desc: Mix beef with garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt. Form into small patties around 60g each. Keep cold until you cook them — they hold their shape better.

phases.name: Secret Sauce
phases.desc: Mix ketchup, mayonnaise, mustard, and a splash of gherkin brine. That is it. That is the secret. Make twice as much as you think you need.

phases.name: Roast the Fries
phases.desc: Cut potatoes into thin chips. Toss in oil and salt. Spread on trays in a single layer. Roast until golden, crisp, and irresistible. 200°C / 390°F

phases.name: Cook the Patties
phases.desc: Hot pan, 3–4 minutes each side. Add cheese for the final minute and cover with a lid. Cook in batches and keep warm in a low oven.

phases.name: Build the Station
phases.desc: Set up the build-your-own station. Warm the buns first. Let the children assemble their own — the food becomes the activity. Embrace the chaos.

pairings: Homemade milkshakes or fresh fruit smoothies
Birthday cake arrives separately, to cheers

occasions.recipeTitle: Golden Mezze Board: Whipped Feta, Hummus, Warm Flatbreads & Falafel

swaps.text: the entire spread is already plant-based
replace flatbreads with crudités
sunflower seed butter instead of tahini

phases.name: Make the Hummus
phases.desc: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon, garlic and ice-cold water until impossibly smooth. Season very aggressively — hummus wants more salt than you think.

phases.name: Whip the Feta
phases.desc: Blend feta with Greek yogurt and a squeeze of lemon until silky and spreadable. Top with good olive oil and za'atar just before serving.

phases.name: Prep the Vegetables
phases.desc: Halve cherry tomatoes. Slice cucumber into batons. Tear herbs loosely. Arrange everything in natural clusters — not rows. This is the difference between good and great.

phases.name: Char the Breads
phases.desc: Directly over a gas flame or in a very dry hot pan. The char is not an accident — it adds smokiness and warmth that elevates everything else on the board.

phases.name: Assemble the Board
phases.desc: Arrange dips, vegetables, and breads on large boards or trays. Pour olive oil generously over everything. Scatter za'atar. The board arrives, and people feel immediately cared for.

pairings: Dry rosé, gin & tonic, or pomegranate spritz
Add warm marinated olives as a second board

occasions.recipeTitle: Sticky Tamarind & Honey BBQ Chicken with Charred Corn & Herb Slaw

swaps.text: aubergine & halloumi, same glaze, 20 min BBQ
glazed tofu & tempeh hold the char beautifully
plain grilled chicken, ketchup on the side, separate plate

phases.name: Marinate
phases.desc: Mix tamarind, honey, soy, garlic, ginger and chilli into a thick paste. Coat chicken thighs entirely. Overnight gives flavour that goes all the way to the bone.

phases.name: BBQ or Oven
phases.desc: On the BBQ over indirect heat, or 200°C in the oven. Baste with remaining marinade halfway through. The glaze caramelises into something smoky and extraordinary. 200°C / 390°F

phases.name: Char the Corn
phases.desc: Directly over the BBQ flame or under a scorching grill. The char is the point — it adds sweetness, smoke, and a visual drama that makes the whole spread sing.

phases.name: Make the Slaw
phases.desc: Shred cabbage and carrot finely. Toss with vinegar, sugar, salt and coriander. The slaw collapses beautifully as the evening progresses and improves with every minute.

phases.name: Serve Outdoors
phases.desc: Pile everything onto large boards. Let people serve themselves. A squeeze of lime over everything at the table is non-negotiable. The garden does the rest.

pairings: Cold lager, Aperol spritz, or fresh lemonade
Jasmine rice or warm naan alongside

occasions.recipeTitle: Pan-Seared Duck Breast with Cherry & Port Sauce
occasions.cuisine: French · Romantic · For Two · Scales to 12

swaps.text: roasted beetroot steaks with the same cherry sauce
pan-seared salmon with dill butter, no port sauce
chicken breast, same pan method, sauce made mild

phases.name: Score
phases.desc: Score the duck skin in a diamond pattern, cutting through fat but not flesh. Season generously with salt and rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.

phases.name: Render
phases.desc: Cold pan, skin-side down. Render the fat slowly over medium heat until the skin is deep golden and glass-crisp. This cannot be rushed.

phases.name: Roast
phases.desc: Flip and finish in the oven. Medium-rare: 10 minutes. A thermometer removes all doubt: 54°C internal. 180°C / 355°F

phases.name: Cherry Sauce
phases.desc: Pour off excess fat. Deglaze with port. Add stock, shallots and cherries. Reduce until glossy and coating. Finish with cold butter.

phases.name: Rest & Serve
phases.desc: Rest the duck 8 minutes minimum. Slice on the diagonal against the grain. Sauce pooled on a warm plate. This is the dish.

pairings: Burgundy Pinot Noir or aged Côtes du Rhône
Chicory, walnut and pear salad to start

occasions.recipeTitle: Herb-Crusted Rack of Lamb with Roasted Garlic Mash

swaps.text: baked portobello stack with herb crust, 25 min at 200°C
herb-crusted salmon en croûte, same bake
chicken supremes, same herb crust, 25 min at 190°C

phases.name: Herb Crust
phases.desc: Blitz breadcrumbs with parsley, rosemary, garlic and olive oil to a vibrant green paste. It should be bright, fragrant and taste like the garden.

phases.name: Sear
phases.desc: Brown racks on all sides in a very hot pan. Bone side first, then fat side. The colour builds flavour — this step is not optional.

phases.name: Crust & Roast
phases.desc: Coat fat side with Dijon. Press herb crust firmly. Roast until fragrant and deeply golden. Pink inside: non-negotiable. 200°C / 390°F

phases.name: Rest
phases.desc: Cover loosely and leave it completely alone. The lamb continues cooking as it rests. 10 minutes gives you pink. 15 gives you medium.

phases.name: Carve at the Table
phases.desc: Cut into individual cutlets. Stand the racks upright against each other. This is how you make an entrance. This is the graduation.

pairings: A good Bordeaux or Barolo
Pea and fresh mint soup to start

occasions.recipeTitle: Slow-Cooked Beef Bourguignon with Crusty Bread

swaps.text: whole roasted celeriac and root veg, same braising liquid
monkfish and chorizo stew, same method, less time
chicken thighs braised separately, same vegetables and sauce

phases.name: Marinate
phases.desc: Submerge beef in red wine with herbs, garlic and vegetables overnight if possible. The wine tenderises every fibre and deepens every flavour.

phases.name: Sear
phases.desc: Brown beef in batches over high heat. Every batch needs space. Do not skip this. Dark crust equals deep flavour — this is where the dish is built.

phases.name: Build the Braise
phases.desc: Bacon lardons, pearl onions, mushrooms, the wine marinade, stock. Everything in together. Season generously. This is the whole recipe.

phases.name: Braise
phases.desc: Covered, low and slow. Check once, adjust nothing. The house will smell extraordinary. 150°C / 300°F

phases.name: Rest & Serve
phases.desc: Best made the day before — the flavour deepens overnight. Serve with crusty bread to catch every last drop of the sauce.

pairings: Burgundy Pinot Noir — the same wine as the pot
Simple green salad first, cheese board after

occasions.recipeTitle: Preserved Lemon Roast Chicken with Herbed Couscous & Olives

swaps.text: whole roasted cauliflower, same marinade, 45 min at 190°C
aubergine steaks and chickpeas, same spices, same table
plain roasted chicken thighs, no marinade, same couscous

phases.name: Marinate
phases.desc: Rub chickens inside and out with preserved lemon, garlic, cumin and olive oil. Push seasoning under the skin too — loosen it with your fingers.

phases.name: Roast
phases.desc: Olives, onions and lemon pieces arranged around the base. The cooking juices become the sauce. The kitchen fills with something extraordinary. 180°C / 355°F

phases.name: Couscous
phases.desc: Pour boiling stock over couscous and cover tightly. Wait 5 minutes exactly. Fluff with a fork. Add herbs, a squeeze of lemon, a thread of olive oil.

phases.name: Rest
phases.desc: Tent with foil. The skin crisps further. The juices redistribute. The smell deepens. Leave it alone for 15 minutes.

phases.name: Serve Family Style
phases.desc: Bring the whole birds to the table and carve there. The smell is the welcome. It arrives before the food does.

pairings: Dry rosé or a crisp white Viognier
Warm flatbreads and hummus while you wait

occasions.recipeTitle: Individual Beef Wellingtons with Mushroom Duxelles & Red Wine Jus
occasions.cuisine: British · Fine Dining · Special Occasion · Serves 6–16

swaps.text: mushroom, spinach and goat's cheese Wellington, same bake
salmon Wellington with dill cream, 20 min at 200°C
chicken fillet wrapped in Parma ham and pastry, same bake

phases.name: Duxelles
phases.desc: Blitz mushrooms, shallots and garlic. Cook in butter until completely dry — this is the most important step. Wet duxelles makes soggy pastry.

phases.name: Sear & Wrap
phases.desc: Sear beef portions hard and fast. Cool completely. Wrap in Parma ham and duxelles, then in puff pastry. Egg wash and seal tightly.

phases.name: Chill
phases.desc: Refrigerate the wrapped Wellingtons. This sets the shape and gives you complete control over timing. Can be done hours ahead.

phases.name: Bake
phases.desc: Until deep golden. 52°C internal for perfect medium-rare. The kitchen will smell extraordinary. 220°C / 430°F

phases.name: Rest & Reveal
phases.desc: Rest 5 minutes only — the pastry holds the heat. Slice at the table. The reveal is the moment you planned the evening for.

pairings: Premier Cru Bordeaux or an exceptional Barolo
Champagne on arrival — this is the occasion for it

occasions.recipeTitle: Pan-Roasted Halibut with Saffron Beurre Blanc & Samphire

swaps.text: pan-seared tofu steak with the same beurre blanc and samphire
swap halibut for sea bass, cod or turbot
plain pan-fried chicken breast, same potatoes, butter sauce only

phases.name: Potatoes
phases.desc: Simmer new potatoes in well-salted water until tender. Drain, crush lightly, finish in butter and fresh tarragon. Keep warm in a low oven.

phases.name: Beurre Blanc
phases.desc: Reduce white wine with shallots and saffron to 2 tablespoons. Add cream, reduce again. Whisk in cold butter piece by piece until silky and golden.

phases.name: Samphire
phases.desc: Blanch briefly in unsalted boiling water — it is already salty. Taste before adding any seasoning. Its natural salinity is part of the dish.

phases.name: Sear the Halibut
phases.desc: Very hot pan, olive oil. Skin side first until golden. Flip once only. Halibut is delicate and rewards careful attention.

phases.name: Plate & Serve
phases.desc: Potatoes first, fish on top, sauce pooled, samphire alongside. Each plate should look deliberate. This is the upscale dinner party moment.

pairings: White Burgundy or a great Chablis
Krug or Billecart-Salmon on arrival

occasions.recipeTitle: Champagne Risotto with Saffron, Crispy Prosciutto & Truffle Oil

swaps.text: the base risotto is already vegetarian — use vegetable stock
plant butter and nutritional yeast instead of dairy
plain risotto bianco, no truffle oil or prosciutto, same base

phases.name: Warm the Stock
phases.desc: Steep saffron in warm stock for 10 minutes — it needs time to bleed its colour and flavour. Keep stock at a gentle simmer throughout. Cold stock ruins risotto.

phases.name: Toast & Deglaze
phases.desc: Soften shallots in butter. Toast rice until each grain is translucent and crackling slightly. Deglaze with champagne. The sizzle is the moment the dish begins.

phases.name: Build
phases.desc: One ladle of warm stock at a time, stirring almost constantly. This is the meditative work of risotto. Patience here returns itself with every mouthful.

phases.name: Crispy Prosciutto
phases.desc: Lay flat on a tray. Bake at 180°C until glass-crisp. This is the texture contrast the whole dish is built around.

phases.name: Finish & Serve
phases.desc: Parmesan, cold butter, a few drops of truffle oil off the heat. Taste and correct. Serve immediately. Risotto waits for nobody.

pairings: The rest of the champagne, obviously
Rocket, pear and aged Parmesan to start

occasions.recipeTitle: Prawn & Chorizo Linguine with Cherry Tomatoes, White Wine & Basil
occasions.cuisine: Italian · Spanish-Fusion · For Two · Scales to 12

swaps.text: roasted peppers, courgette and smoked paprika — no prawns or chorizo
the vegetarian version is already vegan
plain pasta with butter and Parmesan served alongside

phases.name: Mise en Place
phases.desc: Slice the chorizo. Halve the tomatoes. Open the wine. Have a glass. This dish rewards relaxed confidence more than anything else you can bring to it.

phases.name: Chorizo First
phases.desc: Fry chorizo until the fat renders and turns a deep paprika red. This oil is the flavour base for the entire dish. Do not drain it. Not a drop.

phases.name: Build the Sauce
phases.desc: Prawns into the chorizo oil. Cherry tomatoes, white wine, garlic, chilli. Let it reduce to a loose and vibrant sauce. Taste. Adjust.

phases.name: Pasta
phases.desc: Linguine in aggressively salted boiling water. Reserve a full cup of pasta water before draining — it finishes the sauce beautifully.

phases.name: Combine & Serve
phases.desc: Toss pasta in the sauce. Add pasta water to loosen. Basil torn over at the last second. Pecorino at the table, not before.

pairings: Chilled Albarino or a dry Vermentino
Good bread and olive oil while you cook together

occasions.recipeTitle: Honey-Glazed Chicken Skewers with Tabbouleh, Flatbreads & Labneh

swaps.text: halloumi skewers with the same honey-paprika glaze
cauliflower florets, same glaze, same grill time
plain grilled chicken, no glaze, same tabbouleh

phases.name: Marinate
phases.desc: Mix honey, mustard, paprika, garlic and olive oil. Coat the chicken thighs entirely. Overnight gives the deepest flavour and the most beautiful colour.

phases.name: Tabbouleh
phases.desc: Soak bulgur in hot water, drain and cool. Toss with abundant parsley, mint, tomatoes, cucumber, olive oil and lemon. It should be mostly herb, not mostly grain.

phases.name: Grill or Roast
phases.desc: Skewers over a hot grill or at 200°C in the oven. Baste with remaining marinade halfway. The honey chars slightly at the edges. 200°C / 390°F

phases.name: Rest
phases.desc: 5 minutes off the heat. The honey glaze sets. The juices redistribute. The colour deepens further.

phases.name: Serve the Board
phases.desc: Boards of skewers, tabbouleh, warm flatbreads and labneh. Spring colour, zero stress. Let everyone build their own plate.

pairings: Elderflower cordial or sparkling water with mint
Fresh berry pavlova to follow

occasions.recipeTitle: Slow-Roasted Herb-Crusted Beef Topside with Yorkshire Puddings & Red Wine Gravy

swaps.text: roasted butternut squash crown with herb crust, same presentation
whole baked side of salmon with dill and lemon cream
plain sliced roast beef, no herb crust, same gravy and puddings

phases.name: Herb Crust
phases.desc: Blitz rosemary, thyme, garlic and olive oil to a thick paste. Mix with Dijon mustard. Cover the beef joint entirely on all surfaces.

phases.name: Sear
phases.desc: Brown all surfaces in a smoking-hot roasting tin. This builds the caramelised crust that carries the gravy and makes the kitchen smell like a celebration.

phases.name: Slow Roast
phases.desc: Low and slow. Medium-rare at 58°C internal for a crowd. Use a thermometer. 160°C / 320°F

phases.name: Rest
phases.desc: The most important step. 30 minutes under foil before carving. This makes or breaks the dish — do not rush it.

phases.name: Carve at the Table
phases.desc: Carve on a board at the table. The drama and the smell do the work. Yorkshire puddings and gravy arrive last.

pairings: A serious Bordeaux or a full-bodied Burgundy
Prawn cocktails to start, nostalgically

occasions.recipeTitle: Slow-Roasted Duck Legs with Orange & Star Anise, Crispy Potatoes & Braised Red Cabbage

swaps.text: five-spice roasted aubergine and tofu, same glaze, 35 min
the vegetarian option is already vegan
plain roasted chicken thighs, no marinade, same potatoes

phases.name: Score & Marinate
phases.desc: Score duck skin in a crosshatch pattern. Rub with five-spice, orange zest, garlic and ginger. The fat needs scoring to render properly overnight.

phases.name: Slow Roast
phases.desc: Duck legs skin-side up. The fat renders slowly, continuously basting the meat below. 160°C / 320°F

phases.name: Braised Red Cabbage
phases.desc: Shred cabbage finely. Braise with red wine vinegar, sugar and star anise while the duck cooks. Better made the day before.

phases.name: Blast the Skin
phases.desc: Increase oven to 220°C / 430°F for the final 15 minutes. The skin turns lacquered, deep and glass-crisp. 220°C / 430°F

phases.name: Glaze & Serve
phases.desc: Brush with honey-soy-orange glaze at the last moment. Serve on a board. The smell alone announces the new year.

pairings: Pinot Noir or a rich Côtes du Rhône
Champagne at midnight, obviously

occasions.recipeTitle: Maple & Herb Roasted Turkey Crown with Cornbread Stuffing & Cranberry Sauce

swaps.text: whole stuffed butternut squash, same herb butter and glaze
same squash option with plant butter and maple
plain roasted turkey breast, no glaze, same stuffing and cranberry

phases.name: Herb Butter Under the Skin
phases.desc: Blend soft butter with sage, thyme, garlic and salt. Push it under the crown skin with your fingers. This is the step that keeps every slice juicy.

phases.name: Maple Glaze
phases.desc: Mix maple syrup with a knob of butter. Brush over the crown at the start and every 30 minutes. The lacquer builds with each coat.

phases.name: Roast
phases.desc: Baste every 30 minutes without fail. The maple builds a deep amber crust. 180°C / 355°F

phases.name: Cornbread Stuffing
phases.desc: Crumble cornbread with sautéed celery, onion and sage. Moisten with stock. Bake separately for a crisp golden top.

phases.name: Cranberry Sauce & Carve
phases.desc: Simmer cranberries with orange juice and sugar until glossy. Carve the crown at the table with ceremony.

pairings: A rich Pinot Gris or a good California Chardonnay
Pumpkin pie to finish, always

occasions.recipeTitle: Slow-Roasted Leg of Lamb with Mint & Pea Sauce, Rosemary Potatoes & Spring Greens

swaps.text: whole roasted cauliflower with herb crust, 45 min at 190°C, same mint sauce
same cauliflower option with coconut crème fraîche in the sauce
plain roasted chicken thighs, no garlic studding, same potatoes

phases.name: Stud & Rub
phases.desc: Push garlic slivers and rosemary sprigs deep into slits cut across the lamb. Rub all over with olive oil, mustard and salt. Massage it in thoroughly.

phases.name: Slow Roast
phases.desc: This is patient cooking. The lamb rewards you generously at the end. 160°C / 320°F

phases.name: Mint & Pea Sauce
phases.desc: Blend cooked peas with fresh mint, crème fraîche and lemon until vivid green and smooth. This sauce IS the spring. Make it just before serving.

phases.name: Rosemary Potatoes
phases.desc: Parboil, rough up the edges, roast in olive oil and rosemary until deeply golden. The best potatoes this table will ever eat.

phases.name: Rest & Carve
phases.desc: 30 minutes under foil. The lamb should pull apart with two forks at this point. Serve on a board — the spring colours do the work.

pairings: A bright Bordeaux or a Côtes du Rhône Blanc
Hot cross buns with good butter to start

occasions.recipeTitle: Butter Chicken with Basmati Rice, Saag Paneer & Warm Naan Breads

swaps.text: replace chicken with chickpeas and extra paneer — the sauce is already vegetarian
coconut cream instead of dairy, tofu instead of paneer
plain naan with butter, minimal spice in a separate portion

phases.name: Marinate the Chicken
phases.desc: Toss chicken in yogurt, garam masala, cumin and turmeric. Overnight gives real depth. The acid in the yogurt tenderises every piece.

phases.name: Char the Chicken
phases.desc: Grill or roast at 220°C / 430°F until the edges are slightly charred. This is the step that makes it taste like a restaurant. 220°C / 430°F

phases.name: Build the Sauce
phases.desc: Butter, garlic and ginger base. Tomatoes, cream, more spice. Reduce until rich and coating. Add the charred chicken and simmer gently.

phases.name: Saag Paneer
phases.desc: Pan-fry paneer cubes until golden. Wilt spinach with garlic and spices. Combine. This cooks simultaneously with the sauce.

phases.name: Serve Family Style
phases.desc: Both dishes centred on the table with basmati and warm naan. The house smells like it has been lived in for years.

pairings: Cold lager or a mango lassi
Mango chutney and lime pickle on the table

occasions.recipeTitle: Whole Baked Salmon Sides with Dill & Lemon, Crushed New Potatoes & Cucumber Crème Fraîche

swaps.text: whole roasted cauliflower with dill and lemon treatment, same sauce
same cauliflower with coconut crème fraîche
plain baked salmon fillet, no herbs, same potatoes and cucumber sauce

phases.name: Prep the Salmon
phases.desc: Lay sides skin-down on parchment. Season generously. Lay dill fronds and lemon slices along the full length. Drizzle with olive oil and white wine.

phases.name: Bake
phases.desc: Covered with foil for the first 20 minutes, uncovered for the last 10. The salmon is done when it flakes at the thickest point. 180°C / 355°F

phases.name: Cucumber Crème Fraîche
phases.desc: Grate and squeeze dry the cucumber. Fold into crème fraîche with fresh dill, capers and lemon. Cold, clean and bright against the warm fish.

phases.name: Crushed Potatoes
phases.desc: Boil new potatoes, drain and crush roughly with butter, salt and dill. Not mashed, not whole. Somewhere in between.

phases.name: Rest & Serve
phases.desc: Let the salmon cool 5 minutes. Serve it on the baking parchment on a board. The presentation does all the work.

pairings: Champagne or a crisp white Burgundy
Cornichons and blinis as nibbles before

occasions.recipeTitle: The Big Match: Build-Your-Own Chilli Station with Nachos, Sour Cream & Guacamole

swaps.text: black beans and lentils in place of beef, same spices and sauce
the vegetarian version is already vegan — skip sour cream and cheese
plain beef mince in mild tomato sauce, separate bowl, same chips

phases.name: Brown the Beef
phases.desc: In batches over high heat. Do not crowd the pan — steam makes grey meat. Sear makes flavour. Take your time with each batch.

phases.name: Build the Base
phases.desc: Onions, garlic, chipotle paste, cumin, smoked paprika. Add tomatoes and stock. This is the whole recipe in three steps and it cannot go wrong.

phases.name: Slow Braise
phases.desc: Cover and leave it. The beef breaks down and the sauce deepens. Add the dark chocolate in the last 10 minutes. 160°C / 300°F

phases.name: Set Up the Station
phases.desc: Chips, sour cream, grated cheddar, guacamole, jalapenos — each in their own bowl. The station is the dish.

phases.name: Hold & Serve
phases.desc: Chilli holds on the hob for 4 hours and improves. Set it up before kick-off. Serve whenever the room needs feeding.

pairings: Cold beer — all kinds, all welcome
Extra tortilla chips — always run out first

occasions.recipeTitle: Smoky Pumpkin & Chorizo Chilli with Black Beans, Chipotle Crema & Corn Chips

swaps.text: skip the chorizo — use smoked paprika and a tablespoon of olive oil as the base fat instead
the vegetarian version is already vegan — replace sour cream with coconut yogurt
plain baked potato with mild tomato sauce, served alongside the main dish

phases.name: Roast the Squash
phases.desc: Cube squash, toss in olive oil, smoked paprika and cumin. Roast until caramelised at the edges. The colour is already perfect for Halloween. 200°C / 390°F

phases.name: Fry the Chorizo
phases.desc: The chorizo releases its deep red oil as it fries. This is the fat everything else cooks in. Do not drain a drop of it.

phases.name: Build the Chilli
phases.desc: Onions, garlic and chipotle paste in the chorizo fat. Add tomatoes and stock and black beans. The colour deepens to almost black.

phases.name: Combine & Simmer
phases.desc: Add the roasted squash and let everything become one. The sauce grows darker and deeper with every minute. 160°C / 320°F

phases.name: Serve with Drama
phases.desc: Ladle into carved pumpkin bowls if you have them. Chipotle crema, coriander and lime alongside. Tortilla chips for dipping.

pairings: Spiced apple cider or a bold Malbec
Extra tortilla chips — they disappear first

occasions.recipeTitle: Smoked Salmon & Dill Eggs Benedict with Hollandaise, Avocado & Herb Salad

swaps.text: wilted spinach and roasted cherry tomatoes in place of smoked salmon
silken tofu scramble on toast with avocado — skip the hollandaise entirely
scrambled eggs on buttered toast — no poaching, no hollandaise required

phases.name: Hollandaise
phases.desc: Whisk egg yolks over barely simmering water with a splash of white wine vinegar. Add melted butter drop by drop. This is the one step that asks for attention. Give it.

phases.name: Poach the Eggs
phases.desc: Deep pan, barely simmering water, a splash of vinegar. Swirl gently. A perfect poached egg is entirely achievable if the water is calm and the eggs are cold.

phases.name: Smash the Avocado
phases.desc: Rough smash with lemon juice, salt and a pinch of chilli flakes. Not too smooth — texture is half the dish.

phases.name: Toast the Muffins
phases.desc: Split, toasted until golden on the cut side only. The contrast between the crisp base and the yielding egg above is the architecture of the dish.

phases.name: Assemble in Order
phases.desc: Muffin → avocado → smoked salmon → poached egg → hollandaise → dill. The order matters. Serve the moment it lands.

pairings: Champagne or a Buck's Fizz
Very good coffee, served properly

occasions.recipeTitle: Slow-Smoked Beef Brisket with Bourbon BBQ Glaze, Pickled Red Onions & Homemade Slaw

swaps.text: whole roasted celeriac with the same spice rub, 3 hrs at 160°C
same celeriac with plant-based mayo in the slaw
plain sliced beef with no glaze — same slaw and pickles on the side

phases.name: The Rub — Night Before
phases.desc: Mix smoked paprika, sugar, pepper, garlic powder and onion powder. Cover the brisket entirely. Overnight in the fridge. This is not optional — the rub needs time.

phases.name: Low & Slow
phases.desc: The brisket should not be rushed. At 8 hours the bark is set and the meat yields completely with no effort. 120°C / 250°F

phases.name: Bourbon BBQ Sauce
phases.desc: Simmer bourbon, ketchup, vinegar and Worcestershire until glossy. The alcohol cooks off. What remains is depth and complexity.

phases.name: Pickled Onions & Slaw
phases.desc: Slice red onions into hot white wine vinegar brine. Dress cabbage and carrot with mayonnaise and vinegar. Both improve as they sit.

phases.name: Rest & Pull
phases.desc: 45 minutes under foil before pulling. A table that waited 8 hours can wait another 45. The patience pays every time.

pairings: A cold IPA or a serious American Bourbon
Cornbread or brioche buns on the side

occasions.recipeTitle: Build-Your-Own Mexican Taco Fiesta with Slow-Cooked Pulled Beef, Grilled Corn & Guacamole

swaps.text: spiced black beans and roasted peppers — same toppings, same station
the black bean version is already vegan — replace sour cream with coconut yogurt
plain beef in a soft flour tortilla, no spice, just cheese and sour cream

phases.name: Season & Sear
phases.desc: Rub beef all over with cumin, paprika, chipotle and salt. Sear every surface in a smoking-hot pot. The crust is where the flavour lives.

phases.name: Braise
phases.desc: Into the pot with tomatoes, stock and garlic. Cover and leave. Pull apart when it yields completely to two forks. 160°C / 320°F

phases.name: Grilled Corn
phases.desc: Grill corn cobs directly over gas or a griddle until visibly charred. Slice off the kernels. They go into everything and add sweetness.

phases.name: Guacamole & Salsa
phases.desc: Rough-smash avocado with lime and salt. Dice tomatoes and red onion. Neither needs to be precise. The energy of the occasion allows for some mess.

phases.name: Set the Fiesta Table
phases.desc: Everything in bowls. Tortillas warm in foil. Let the table build its own plates. The noise and colour are the point of the whole occasion.

pairings: Margaritas or hibiscus agua fresca
A reveal cake for after — whichever colour it is

occasions.recipeTitle: Slow-Roasted Spiced Lamb Shoulder with Flatbreads, Tzatziki & Tabbouleh

swaps.text: whole roasted cauliflower head with the same spice rub, 1.5 hrs at 190°C
same cauliflower with coconut yogurt tzatziki instead of dairy
plain roasted chicken thighs, no spice rub — same flatbreads and tzatziki

phases.name: Spice Rub — Night Before
phases.desc: Mix cumin, coriander, paprika and cinnamon with olive oil into a thick paste. Rub into every surface of the lamb. Refrigerate overnight for maximum depth.

phases.name: Slow Roast
phases.desc: The shoulder is done when the bone slides out with no resistance at all. This is an honest 5 hours. It rewards the patience completely. 150°C / 300°F

phases.name: Tzatziki
phases.desc: Grate cucumber and squeeze completely dry. Fold into Greek yogurt with fresh mint, garlic and lemon. Cold and clean against the warm lamb.

phases.name: Tabbouleh
phases.desc: Soak bulgur, drain, cool. Toss with lavish amounts of parsley, mint, cherry tomatoes and lemon. More herb than grain — always.

phases.name: Pull at the Table
phases.desc: This is the centrepiece dish. The lamb arrives whole and is pulled apart at the table. That informality is the spirit of an open house.

pairings: A Syrah or a warm-spiced Grenache
Hummus and roasted red peppers alongside

occasions.recipeTitle: Roast Chicken with Golden Broth, Challah & Honey-Glazed Root Vegetables

swaps.text: whole roasted cauliflower with the same herb rub, same root vegetables alongside
same cauliflower with vegetable broth instead — use saffron for the golden colour
plain roasted chicken breast, no herbs, same vegetables and torn challah

phases.name: Prep the Chicken
phases.desc: Pat completely dry — this is the single most important step for golden skin. Rub inside and out with olive oil, lemon zest, garlic and thyme. Season generously.

phases.name: Roast
phases.desc: Vegetables underneath the chicken become the flavour foundation for the broth. The bird is done when the juices run completely clear. 180°C / 355°F

phases.name: The Golden Broth
phases.desc: Lift the rested chicken. Simmer pan juices with stock, turmeric and fresh dill until golden and fragrant. Strain into a warm jug. This is the soul of the table.

phases.name: Honey Root Vegetables
phases.desc: Toss the roasted carrots and parsnips with honey in the last 10 minutes of cooking. The glaze caramelises while the chicken rests.

phases.name: The Table
phases.desc: The challah is torn, not cut. The broth is poured at the table. If there are candles, they were lit before you sat down. The week is behind you now.

pairings: Two candles lit before the meal begins
Kiddush wine or grape juice, poured with ceremony

occasions.recipeTitle: Sabzi Polo Mahi — Herbed Saffron Rice with Tahdig, Pan-Fried Fish & Kuku Sabzi Herb Frittata

ingredients.name: White fish fillets (cod or sea bass)

swaps.text: the kuku sabzi is already vegetarian — serve as the centrepiece with extra herbed rice
replace eggs in the kuku with silken tofu and ground flaxseed — same herbs, same result
plain basmati rice with butter and simply grilled fish, no herb mixing

phases.name: Herbed Saffron Rice
phases.desc: Parboil basmati until just tender. Steep saffron in hot water. Mix the fresh herbs into the drained rice. Layer into the pot with butter and saffron water.

phases.name: The Tahdig
phases.desc: The crispy rice crust at the base of the pot — the most celebrated part of Persian cooking. Cloth under the lid, lowest heat possible. Do not open. The sound tells you when it is ready.

phases.name: Kuku Sabzi
phases.desc: Whisk eggs with a mountain of fresh herbs, spring onions, barberries and walnuts. Cook in a wide pan in olive oil until just set. Cut into wedges.

phases.name: Pan-Fried Fish
phases.desc: Season with turmeric, salt and lemon. Pan-fry until golden — 3 to 4 minutes per side. Simple and ceremonial in equal measure.

phases.name: Turn & Serve
phases.desc: Invert the rice onto a platter — the golden tahdig on top. Everything arrives together. The table looks like the spring equinox arrived inside the room.

pairings: Fresh herb platter — radishes, walnuts, feta
Persian tea with rock sugar served after

occasions.recipeTitle: Slow-Braised Short Ribs in Red Wine with Creamy Polenta & Gremolata

swaps.text: slow-braised portobello mushrooms and puy lentils, same braise and same polenta
same mushroom option with plant butter and nutritional yeast stirred into the polenta
plain buttered tagliatelle instead of polenta — same sauce ladled over

phases.name: Sear the Ribs
phases.desc: Hard sear on every surface in a smoking-hot casserole. The crust is the flavour foundation. Do not crowd the pan — do this in batches if needed.

phases.name: Build the Braise
phases.desc: Onions, garlic and thyme in the same pan. Red wine, tomatoes and stock. Scrape every dark bit from the base. Cover tightly and into the oven.

phases.name: Slow Braise
phases.desc: The ribs are done when the meat falls completely from the bone with no resistance whatsoever. Patience is the only technique required here. 160°C / 320°F

phases.name: Creamy Polenta
phases.desc: Whisk polenta into simmering salted water and milk. Stir continuously. Finish with butter and Parmesan until it coats the spoon heavily. This is the bed the ribs sleep on.

phases.name: Gremolata & Serve
phases.desc: Lemon zest, parsley and a little raw garlic — rough-chopped together. Scattered at the table over the ribs. The brightness cuts through everything.

pairings: A serious Barolo or a bold Nero d'Avola
Good candles — this table deserves them

occasions.recipeTitle: Gravlax with Dill Mustard Sauce, New Potatoes, Pickled Herring & Rye Crispbreads

swaps.text: skip the gravlax — build the table around herbed new potatoes, pickled cucumber, crispbreads and a strong cheese
same table without the dairy — coconut crème fraîche works surprisingly well with dill
plain boiled new potatoes with butter, crispbreads and mild cream cheese

phases.name: Cure the Gravlax
phases.desc: Mix salt, sugar and crushed white pepper. Pack thickly over the salmon with abundant dill. Wrap tightly in cling film. Refrigerate. The cure does everything — you do nothing for 48 hours.

phases.name: Pickled Cucumber
phases.desc: Slice cucumber thinly into hot white wine vinegar with a pinch of sugar and dill. Cool. This is the sharp note that balances the rich cured fish.

phases.name: Dill Mustard Sauce
phases.desc: Whisk Dijon mustard with honey, a splash of white wine vinegar and abundant fresh dill. This sauce is inseparable from gravlax — they complete each other.

phases.name: New Potatoes
phases.desc: Boil in salted water until tender. Drain and toss with cold butter and dill while still hot. They absorb both completely.

phases.name: Set the Midsommar Table
phases.desc: Everything cold, everything fresh, everything arrives together. Gravlax sliced thin at the table. Crispbreads, herring, potatoes and sauces around it. The longest day deserves the longest table.

pairings: Aquavit ice-cold, or elderflower cordial
Fresh strawberries with cream to finish — always

occasions.recipeTitle: Red-Braised Pork Belly with Longevity Noodles, Steamed Whole Fish & Pan-Fried Dumplings

swaps.text: replace pork belly with twice-cooked tofu in the same red braise — same sauce, same colour
tofu braise with mushroom-filled dumplings — both are widely available
plain steamed rice, mild soy-glazed chicken, same dumplings on the side

phases.name: Red-Braise the Pork Belly
phases.desc: Blanch pork belly 5 minutes, drain. Braise in soy, Shaoxing wine, rock sugar, star anise and cinnamon. The colour turns lacquer red. The fat becomes silk. 160°C / 320°F

phases.name: Steam the Whole Fish
phases.desc: Score the fish deeply on both sides. Steam over high heat exactly 12 minutes. Flood with hot sesame oil and soy at the table. A whole fish means prosperity — it is never served already portioned.

phases.name: Pan-Fry the Dumplings
phases.desc: Cold pan, oil, dumplings. High heat until the base is golden and crackling. Add water, cover, steam 5 minutes. Uncover to crisp again. The pleated side faces up always.

phases.name: Longevity Noodles
phases.desc: Boil the noodles but do not cut them — ever. Long noodles mean long life. Breaking them is considered deeply unlucky. Toss in sesame oil and oyster sauce.

phases.name: The New Year Table
phases.desc: Red pork, whole fish, golden dumplings, long noodles. Every dish carries meaning. The table is not decoration — it is a wish made edible.

pairings: Chrysanthemum tea or a light oolong
Red envelopes for the children — always

occasions.recipeTitle: Lamb Rogan Josh with Dal Makhani, Jeera Rice & Warm Naan Breads
occasions.cuisine: Indian · North Indian · Festive Feast · Serves 16–60+

swaps.text: replace lamb with whole roasted cauliflower florets in the same spice base — 45 min
same cauliflower version with coconut yogurt — the dal is already vegan
plain basmati rice with a mild butter sauce — same naan breads

phases.name: The Rogan Josh Base
phases.desc: Brown onions until deeply caramelised — 15 minutes minimum. Garlic and ginger paste, Kashmiri chilli, coriander and cumin. The colour should be brick red before the lamb goes in.

phases.name: Slow Braise
phases.desc: Lamb shoulder sealed in the spice base with tomatoes and yogurt. Low and slow. The yogurt tenderises. The spices deepen. 160°C / 320°F

phases.name: Dal Makhani
phases.desc: Red lentils simmered with onion, tomato, cumin and coconut milk until creamy and rich. This is the dish that steals the table every time. Make double.

phases.name: Jeera Rice
phases.desc: Basmati tempered in butter with whole cumin seeds until they splutter. Add the rice and water. Every grain should be separate and fragrant.

phases.name: The Diwali Table
phases.desc: Both dishes in the centre, basmati and warm naan around them. The table should be lit. Diwali is the Festival of Light — the candles are not optional.

pairings: Diyas — small oil lamps placed around the table
Mango lassi or masala chai to finish

occasions.recipeTitle: New Orleans Chicken & Andouille Gumbo with Dark Roux, White Rice & Hot Sauce Station

swaps.text: replace chicken and sausage with mushrooms, butter beans and extra okra — the roux carries the flavour
the vegetarian version is already vegan — use vegetable stock throughout
plain steamed rice with mild tomato sauce — same cornbread on the side

phases.name: The Dark Roux
phases.desc: Equal parts flour and oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Stir without stopping. The roux goes from blonde to peanut butter to chocolate. Stop at dark chocolate. This is the soul of gumbo and it cannot be rushed.

phases.name: The Holy Trinity
phases.desc: Onions, celery and green pepper — the Creole foundation. Into the hot roux. They sizzle and steam and release everything they have.

phases.name: Build the Gumbo
phases.desc: Garlic, Cajun spice, tomatoes, stock, chicken and sausage. Simmer low. Add okra in the last 30 minutes — it thickens the pot naturally. Low simmer

phases.name: Steamed White Rice
phases.desc: Plain, separate, perfectly cooked long-grain rice. The gumbo is ladled over it at the table — never mixed before serving.

phases.name: Hot Sauce Station
phases.desc: A bottle of Crystal or Tabasco at every place. In New Orleans, adding hot sauce is personal, sacred and non-negotiable. The heat level belongs to each guest.

pairings: Cold Abita beer or a Hurricane cocktail
Music loud enough to cook by — non-negotiable
timeline: Set up hot sauce station & Serve

occasions.recipeTitle: Slow-Smoked BBQ Chicken with Black-Eyed Peas, Collard Greens, Cornbread & Hibiscus Tea

ingredients.name: Smoked bacon or smoked turkey leg

swaps.text: smoked jackfruit with the same dry rub, same roast time — deeply convincing
same jackfruit option — skip the bacon in the peas, use smoked paprika oil instead
plain roasted chicken with no rub — same cornbread and peas alongside

phases.name: Dry Rub — Night Before
phases.desc: Mix smoked paprika, sugar, garlic powder and black pepper. Cover the chicken entirely. Overnight in the fridge. The rub needs time to become the bark.

phases.name: Slow Smoke or Roast
phases.desc: 120°C / 250°F for the first 90 minutes, then blast at 220°C / 430°F for the final 30 minutes. The skin turns lacquered and crackling. 120°C / 250°F

phases.name: Black-Eyed Peas
phases.desc: Simmer with smoked bacon or turkey leg, onion and bay leaves until soft and deeply smoky. These peas carry centuries of tradition to every table they sit on.

phases.name: Collard Greens
phases.desc: Low and slow with apple cider vinegar, onion and a pinch of sugar. Southern greens need time. They should be silky, never crisp. The pot liquor is precious — serve it too.

phases.name: Cornbread & the Table
phases.desc: Cast iron, high heat, golden crust. The hibiscus tea is already cold and deep red in a pitcher. Everything arrives together.

pairings: Strawberry hibiscus agua fresca — cold, red, ceremonial
Gospel music or whatever makes the room feel free

occasions.recipeTitle: Slow-Braised Chicken in Red Mole with Mexican Rice, Tortillas & Toasted Seeds

swaps.text: roasted pumpkin and black beans in the mole instead of chicken — the sauce carries everything
same pumpkin option — the mole base is already vegan
plain chicken in mild tomato sauce, same rice and warm tortillas on the side

phases.name: Toast & Soak the Chillies
phases.desc: Dry-toast ancho and pasilla chillies in a hot pan until the kitchen fills with smoke and fragrance. Remove seeds. Soak in hot water 20 minutes until soft.

phases.name: Blend the Mole Base
phases.desc: Blend soaked chillies with tomatoes, sesame seeds, cumin and cinnamon. It should smell ancient — earthy, smoky, complex. This is the whole architecture of mole.

phases.name: Build & Deepen
phases.desc: Fry onions and garlic dark. Add the blended base. Cook until it deepens in colour. Add stock and broken dark chocolate. The mole thickens as the chocolate melts in.

phases.name: Braise the Chicken
phases.desc: Chicken into the mole. Covered. Barely moving. The sauce becomes the cooking liquid and the sauce simultaneously. 160°C / 320°F

phases.name: The Ofrenda Table
phases.desc: Marigold colours, warm tortillas, rice. Place a plate for whoever is absent — that is the tradition. The dish is for the living and the dead both.

pairings: Horchata or Mexican hot chocolate — both cold and warm
Marigolds on the table — cempasúchitl, the flower of the dead

occasions.recipeTitle: Mansaf — Slow-Braised Lamb in Yogurt Sauce with Saffron Rice, Pine Nuts & Flatbreads

swaps.text: whole roasted aubergines and chickpeas on the saffron rice — same yogurt sauce poured over
same aubergine option with coconut yogurt instead of labneh — stir in a pinch of turmeric for colour
plain rice with mild lamb in tomato sauce — same flatbreads and pine nuts

phases.name: Season & Rest — Overnight
phases.desc: Rub lamb generously with turmeric, cinnamon, cardamom, salt and olive oil. The spice needs to reach the bone. Refrigerate overnight.

phases.name: Brown & Braise
phases.desc: Brown lamb pieces all over in a hot pot. Add stock and onions. Cover tightly and braise until the meat falls from the bone with no resistance. 160°C / 320°F

phases.name: The Yogurt Sauce
phases.desc: The critical step: temper labneh into the warm braising liquid very slowly, stirring constantly. Added cold to hot it will split. The patience here creates the silky ivory sauce that defines mansaf.

phases.name: Saffron Rice
phases.desc: Basmati tempered in ghee with cardamom and saffron water. Every grain should be golden, fragrant and perfectly separate. This rice is not a side — it is half the dish.

phases.name: Assemble the Platter
phases.desc: Rice first, lamb on top, yogurt sauce poured generously over everything. Pine nuts and almonds toasted in ghee scattered last. The platter should look like abundance itself.

pairings: Rose water lemonade or fresh mint tea, ice cold
Baklava and ma'amoul date cookies to finish
